execution_target: Thor official duck-sim, robotd and MuJoCo; fresh simulator reset per row

frozen_invariants.sensory_mapping: unchanged P4 bilateral LPLC2 amplitude = computed looming

seed_disjointness: The six official rows use 884201..884203; offline controls 884204..884205. All are outside historical P8-R0 880901..880906 and draft P8-v2 final ranges 880000..880119, 881000..881023, 882000..882023, 883000..883009.
trial_start_rule: Each of six official rows must have a fresh official reset and a moving pose-derived body plus fresh applied vx >=0.04 m/s before neural observation; all starts remain in the denominator and raw artifact manifest.
exogenous_validity_at_neural_arm: Valid only if official reset/upstream identity and policy readback are correct, initial MuJoCo trunk pose and initial virtual obstacle geometry are finite, fresh pose-derived movement >=0.015 m/s is established for 200 ms, fresh robot.state applied vx >=0.04 m/s, and the fixed representation/seed/arm identity is correct. These conditions are determined before neural observation. A post-arm no-response, late trigger, deadman, fault stop, transport failure, scheduler exception, or renderer failure is an evaluated failure, never excluded or replaced.

matched_pair_baseline_tolerance.clock_domain: same host monotonic nanoseconds; compare elapsed durations, not absolute timestamps

matched_pair_reporting_rule: Log actual reset pose, pre-arm pose speed, applied vx and sample timestamp, scenario anchor/center distance, arm timestamp, and raw frame clocks for each row. A tolerance mismatch does not justify deleting a started row; classify pair comparability failure and retain both raws.
primary_screen: All three candidate rows must have first healthy graph-v2 DNp01/EscapeDecoder stop preserved by SafetyClamp and healthy Watchdog while pose-derived motion persists and evaluator center distance is strictly greater than 0.25 m, before any deadman/fault/scripted/zero stop; report all baseline outcomes but do not infer final P8 rate.
secondary_comparison: For each matched row, report actual RGB frame spacing, pixel-area plateaus, positive looming frames and amplitudes, positive LPLC2 neural steps, DNp01 readout by step, first stop source and event-time evaluator margin; no seed replacement or post-result parameter change.
failure_rule: Retain every started row and failed/infrastructure raw file with SHA256, bytes and record count; if candidate fails primary screen, open a separately versioned encoding hypothesis instead of changing resolution, gain, filter, graph, decoder, threshold or boundary in this protocol.
p8_r1_dependency: Use identical frozen latch source/config in both representations; until P8-R1 is integrated, this matrix may establish only preboundary healthy neural trigger, not sustained stop transport/pose cessation. A separate moving-body causal smoke is required afterward.
